profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Google
profile.summary: Graduated from University of Washington in 2022

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
Implemented a project in Java which connects to an Amazon DynamoDB table which stores historical
registration information of Amazon sellers. Made design decisions to ensure that the implementation fits
well with existing code, ensuring that database operations are efficient for a smooth customer shopping
experience.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Added features and testing to the open source Shaka Packager project to ensure conformance to
DASH-IF Guidelines, and worked with a large codebase written in C++. Shaka Packager takes in mp4
and webm files, and outputs an mpd file with corresponding mp4 files that media files can be shared
for on demand and live services using DASH or HLS file sharing formats.

positions.title: Research Intern
positions.description:
Worked on a Javascript-based interface called Concodeit. Concodeit’s purpose is for people with
limited programming experience to understand concurrency and program simple robotics tasks with
the interface. In this project, I improved the Javascript application, played a major role in collecting
and analyzing data from participants, and was a joint author in publishing a paper on the results.

positions.title: Tutor
positions.description: I tutored at the local tutoring center called Eastside Education from September, 2017 to January, 2019. Students I tutored ranged from older elementary school students to high school students, and subjects I tutored include Math (competition and high school level math), AP Physics, and Computer Science.

positions.title: Bioinformatics Intern
positions.description: As a bioinformatics intern at the Institute for Systems Biology, I worked on analyzing genetic data relating to the disease erythropoiesis using techniques such as Principal Component Analysis (PCA), TSNE, and using packages available in the R programming languages that analyze differential gene expression, while making use of the Linux Bash Command Line.

honors.title: National AP Scholar
honors.description: Achieved a score of 4 or higher on 8 or more exams and an average score of at least 4 on all AP exams taken.

honors.title: IB Diploma
honors.description: Achieved a score of 38 on IB exams, earning the IB diploma for the May 2017 exam session.
